description: The bar chart illustrates execution accuracy results for two methods, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four difficulty categories. The horizontal axis contains the categorical groups labeled (from left to right) Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total, while the vertical axis is labeled “Execution Accuracy” and uses a linear numeric scale with visible tick marks at 20, 30, 40, 50, and 60 (values extending slightly above 60 to accommodate the tallest bars). Each category shows a pair of side-by-side bars: NatSQL is shown in a light blue bar and TA-SQL in a darker blue bar, with numeric value labels printed above each bar. In Simple, NatSQL is 60.21 and TA-SQL is 63.14; in Moderate, NatSQL is 39.64 and TA-SQL is 48.60; in Challenging, NatSQL is 32.32 and TA-SQL is 36.11; and in Total, NatSQL is 51.35 and TA-SQL is 56.19. The bars are grouped by category rather than sorted by value, and there are no additional visual emphases such as outlines, annotations beyond the value labels, or stacked components.
